caption: The drawing is a technical illustration of a candle stand, shown on off-white paper with black ink lines. The candle stand has a square top measuring 12 inches by 20.5 inches, as indicated by dimension lines and labels. The structure consists of a central turned vertical post with a rounded, bulbous section toward the middle and a narrowing both above and below this section. The overall height of the stand is 26 3/8 inches. The stand rests on three curved legs that spread outward at the base, forming tripod support, with each leg measuring 9 1/8 inches outward from the center. Additional details include a circular pivot mechanism under the tabletop, indicated by dashed lines and a central circle. A smaller drawing in the bottom right corner provides an elevation detail of the foot. Text on the right side of the sheet reads: "CANDLE STAND (12306-6) BROOKLYN MUSEUM SCALE 1/8” = 1 INCH ROBERT BRIGADIER 4-7-36." All notations, lines, and texts are rendered in black ink.
